newsitem.title: HONG KONG: H B Int'l in HK$90 mln in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: H B Int'l in HK$90 mln in rights issue.

text.p: H B International Holdings Ltd said on Sunday it is planning to issue 214 million new shares to raise HK$89.88 million through a two-for-five rights issue at HK$0.42 per share.
The telephone designer and manufacturer company said in a statement the subscription price represented a discount of 27.59 percent on the shares' closing price of HK$0.58 on Friday.
About HK$52 million of the proceeds would be used in the development of GSM (Global System for Mobiles) and GSM-related products and the remaining balance for general working capital, it said.

H B International is engaged in the design, manufacture and development of telecommunications products. Its major markets include the United States, Britain, France, Germany, Holland, and Italy. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
